Let me analyze the discussion notes for the lead "Riverside Contact".

Document 9 (Lead Discussion Notes — Riverside Contact, updated 2026-06-03):
- Call 1 (2026-05-02): approved budget envelope of $120k confirmed; procurement PO template ready. → Budget OK
- Call 2 (2026-05-16): Clear need — manual reconciliation runs 11 hours/week and misses SLAs; want go-live inside Q4, committed timeline. → Need OK, Timeline OK
- Call 3 (2026-06-03): Champion is an operations manager who cannot sign; CFO (economic buyer) has not joined and deferred twice. No signature authority. → Authority NOT OK

Document 10 (Lead Discussion Notes — Riverside Contact (update), updated 2026-07-21, supersedes earlier notes where they conflict):
- CFO joined last call and confirmed signing authority is resolved. → Authority OK now
- However, group finance froze the initiative budget pending the H2 review — the $120k envelope is no longer approved. → Budget NOT OK now
- Need and timeline are unchanged. → Need OK, Timeline OK

So the latest notes (07-21, which supersede earlier notes where they conflict) say:
- Budget: NOT OK (frozen, no longer approved)
- Authority: OK (resolved)
- Need: OK (unchanged)
- Timeline: OK (unchanged)

Therefore the lead cannot be qualified due to 'Budget'.
